parameters.content:
## Stage 3a - Discover & Queue Popular Products

Runs daily (or on demand). Rotates through a category list, uses SearXNG + DeepSeek to shortlist real, currently popular products (same discovery logic as Stage 0), then INSERTS them into the persistent `rgh.product_queue` Postgres table instead of processing them immediately.

Dedupes against every product already in the table (not just this run) so repeated daily runs keep adding genuinely NEW products - `ON CONFLICT (product_key) DO NOTHING`. Assigns country_code and review_style to each new row by rotation, so the queue naturally spreads across markets/formats.

Stage 3b (`stage3b-process-queue.json`) is the separate workflow that reads this table row-by-row and writes/publishes the actual reviews.

Requires: SearXNG at http://searxng:8080, a DeepSeek API key (DEEP_SEEK_API_KEY env var, model: deepseek-flash), and an n8n Postgres credential ("RGH Content DB") pointing at the n8n-db Postgres instance (same one n8n already uses), database `n8n`.

parameters.query: SELECT product_key, lower(regexp_replace(brand || ' ' || product_name, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', ' ', 'g')) AS normalized_name FROM rgh.product_queue

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.research_model, messages: [ { role: "system", content: $json.discovery_system_prompt }, { role: "user", content: $json.discovery_user_prompt } ], response_format: { type: "json_object" }, stream: false }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO rgh.product_queue (product_name, brand, category, country_code, review_style, product_key, source_url, discovery_meta, product_images)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
ON CONFLICT (product_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, product_key;
